name: Jasis
title: Descendant of Simeon
summary: Jasis is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the descendants of the tribe of Simeon. He is listed among the leaders of his clans who expanded their settlements. Little is known about him beyond his tribal affiliation and his role among the princes of the tribe of Simeon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Jasis is listed among the descendants of the tribe of Simeon in the genealogical records of Chronicles, as one of the leading men of the tribe.

keyEvents.title: The Princes of Simeon Expand Their Territories
keyEvents.description: Jasis and other leaders of the tribe of Simeon sought new grazing lands and expanded their settlements toward Gedor.

keyEvents.title: Registration of the Heads of Simeon's Clans
keyEvents.description: In connection with the listing of the tribe of Simeon, Jasis and other named individuals were identified as heads of their clans, which had grown in number.

keyEvents.title: Victory over the Hamites
keyEvents.description: The princes of the tribe of Simeon, including Jasis, came to the area near Gedor and defeated the Hamites who lived there, settling in their place because it was good grazing land.
